publicationInterpretation.notFound: Native publication lookup found no publication for this app.

failed-publication.requiredEvidence: Inspect the named failed deployment and bind its failure evidence to an exact source revision; repair and rerun the relevant build/runtime check. Do not infer downtime from status alone.

source-binding.requiredEvidence: Record Replit app ID, exact Git commit/source manifest, deployment ID and artifact identity together; compare divergent source before applying changes.

exact-candidate-verification.requiredEvidence: Run the repository's documented install/build/tests on the exact combined candidate and record command, result, date and commit. Historical checks cannot qualify a changed build.

audience-and-runtime.requiredEvidence: Verify the intended visitor audience, actual URL/build identity, health and primary user journey on the selected deployment.

data-and-payment-contracts.requiredEvidence: For features this build actually offers, verify authentication/owner isolation, persistence, complete export/deletion, consent/opt-out, and test-mode checkout/webhook/cancellation/refund behavior before making the corresponding product promise.

recovery.requiredEvidence: Identify a rollback revision/artifact; where user data is persisted, prove backup restoration and failure recovery in the intended release setup.

overallConclusion: No complete platform release or automated revenue workflow is qualified by this map. It records identities and evidence gaps without changing apps, audiences, source, deployments, payments or messages.
